title: Magnet TV (Bring Your Own Field)
summary: Your pointer is a magnet that warps a live broadcast test pattern, and lifting your hand restores broadcast order with nothing kept.
mechanism: Pointer-captured, per-frame canvas raster warp (radial magnification plus swirl) over an offscreen test pattern; the field exists only while the pointer is down and is never stored or transmitted.
references: the broadcast test pattern / SMPTE colour bars (readymade)
